facts: **Area $=$ base $\times$ height**, where height is the **perpendicular** distance between the base and the opposite side.
A slanted side that is not perpendicular to the chosen base is **not** its height. A side perpendicular to the chosen base can be its height, as in a rectangle.
Area is measured in square units: cm$^{2}$, m$^{2}$.
steps: Identify the base and its matching perpendicular height, which meets the base or its extension at a right angle.
Write the answer with squared units.

workedExamples.solution_text:
The height is $4\text{ m}$: it meets the extension of the $9\text{ m}$ base at a right angle.

$\begin{align*} A&=bh\\ &=9\times4\\ &=36\text{ m}^{2}\end{align*}$

The $6\text{ cm}$ vertical base has a matching horizontal height of $4\text{ cm}$. The $5\text{ cm}$ slanted side is not used.

$\begin{align*} A&=bh\\ &=6\times4\\ &=24\text{ cm}^{2}\end{align*}$

workedExamples.question_text: A parallelogram has a base of $160\text{ mm}$ and a perpendicular height of $7\text{ cm}$. Find its area in $\text{mm}^{2}$.
workedExamples.solution_text:
Convert the height to millimetres before multiplying.

$7\text{ cm}=70\text{ mm}$

$\begin{align*} A&=bh\\ &=160\times70\\ &=11\,200\text{ mm}^{2}\end{align*}$

workedExamples.question_text: A wall in the shape of a parallelogram has a base of $20\text{ m}$ and a perpendicular height of $6\text{ m}$. Each litre of paint covers $5\text{ m}^{2}$ and costs $\$15$. Find the cost of painting the wall.
workedExamples.solution_text:
$\begin{align*} A&=bh\\ &=20\times6\\ &=120\text{ m}^{2}\end{align*}$

Paint needed: $120\div5=24$ litres.

Cost: $24\times15=\$360$.

development.question_text:
A wall in the shape of a parallelogram has a base of $24\text{ m}$ and a perpendicular height of $8\text{ m}$.
Each litre of paint covers $6\text{ m}^{2}$ and costs $\$18$.
Find the cost of painting the wall.
development.solution_text:
$A=bh$
$=24\times8$
$=192\text{ m}^{2}$
Paint needed: $192\div6=32$ litres.
Cost: $32\times18=576$.
The paint costs $\$576$.
